subject: Post-demo: MindWave integration evaluation & implementation asks
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Todd Larson <todd.larson@mindwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — quick recap & next steps from today's demo

Todd / Sasha — thanks again for your time today. High-level recap and the next steps we discussed so the team can align: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- Real-time triage assistant for support tickets (~50 QPS peak) that must return structured JSON actions (category, urgency, suggested reply) for direct ingestion into your workflow engine.
- Re-ranking of agent suggestions using embeddings over internal KB; must preserve privacy for PII and support controlled token retention.
- A low-latency streaming path for initial snippets (sub-300ms first-token for short prompts) and a more cost-efficient bulk path for longer generations.
- Minimal SDK changes on your side — prefer our streaming + function-calling client with an optional embeddings API for reranking.

Risks / constraints called out:
- MindWave wants GDPR/EU residency for EU customer data; some production sandboxes already in GCP europe-west1.
- Internal security review requires SOC 2 evidence and a short architecture diagram showing request flow and KV-cache handling.
- Tight rollout window: pilot with 50 agents by August 15.

Agreed next steps (owners & rough dates):
1) I will send an initial scope doc and SOW template for your review — by Wed 6/2 (Grace).
2) Priyom will propose a minimal SDK integration plan (streaming + function calling) and a timeline for a POC embed/rerank loop — by Fri 6/4 (Priyom).
3) Ben will set up a short security checklist and SOC2 evidence bundle; we can share an access link to the evidence room — by Thu 6/3 (Ben).
4) Todd / Sasha to confirm which dataset will be used for the rerank POC and whether EU residency is required for the pilot — by Fri 6/4 (MindWave).

Attachments: I attached a lightweight MVP scope doc (MindWave_MVP_scope.pdf) and our SOW template for reference.

If that aligns, I suggest we schedule a 30-minute technical sync next week with your engineering lead and our runtime engineer (Priyom) to walk the integration path. I will book a few slots after you confirm time zones.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--

Attachment: redwood_sow_template.docx (docx, 95 KB)

From: Todd Larson <todd.larson@mindwave.ai>

Cc: Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@mindwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 May 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick recap & next steps from today's demo

Grace — this is perfect, thanks for the concise summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) EU residency: for the pilot, only customer data from EU-based customers needs to stay in eu-west. Internal testing data can live in us-central for now. We'll flag any EU customer records ahead of time.
2) Rerank dataset: Sasha will share a sanitized dump of 10k KB vectors (no PII) to test embed-based reranking.
3) SLA/latency: initial expectation is P95 < 400ms for the streaming snippet path. For full generation the requirement is P95 < 1.2s.

We can do a technical sync next Wed (6/9) 09:00 PT or Thu (6/10) 11:00 PT — either works.

I'll loop in our platform engineer next call (Samir) for the technical sync.

Todd
Todd Larson
Head of Platform Engineering | MindWave AI

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Todd Larson <todd.larson@mindwave.ai>, Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@mindwave.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jun 2027 07:58:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed POC integration plan (streaming + rerank)

Todd / Sasha — following Grace's summary, here's a compact POC plan we can execute in 4 weeks: 

Objective: Demonstrate a streaming-first triage flow with an embeddings-backed reranker integrated into MindWave's ticketing pipeline.

POC scope (minimal):
- Use Redwood streaming API (client SDK) to emit structured JSON events for the first-pass triage (fields: category, urgency, suggested_reply_template, confidence).
- Accept function-calls on our side for action routing (e.g., "create_draft_reply", "escalate"). We'll provide example schema and client stubs.
- Reranker: generate embeddings via our embeddings endpoint; use approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) on your side (we'll provide vectors and stable IDs).
- Data handling: we recommend prefix-based caching for repeated agent prompts and a 72-hour token retention window configurable per-tenant.

Integration work (who/what):
- Redwood: provide SDK patch (minor) with streaming + structured output example, function-calling schema files, and a quickstart repo.
- MindWave: wire the SDK into the ticketing microservice, add a small ANN consumer to call our embedding batch endpoint.

Deliverables & timeline:
- Week 1: repo + SDK sample + function schema (Redwood)
- Week 2: MindWave integrates SDK in staging; share test harness and sample dataset (MindWave)
- Week 3: end-to-end test, latency tuning, and security checklist review
- Week 4: pilot sign-off and export of metrics for SLA gating

Questions / open decisions:
- Is your ticketing microservice able to accept JSON-first streaming payloads, or do we need to wrap with a short-lived ingestion lambda?
- Confirm whether EU residency applies only to persistence layer or also to inference nodes (we can recommend region pinning).

I'll drop the proposed SDK diff and the function-call schema into the Drive folder linked below. If you confirm the Wed 6/9 09:00 PT slot, I'll block time and invite Samir.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

--

From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@mindwave.ai>

Date: Thu, 02 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed POC integration plan (streaming + rerank)

Thanks — this plan looks good. Quick notes from infra/security: 

- We'll aim to share the sanitized 10k KB vector bundle by EOD Fri (6/4).
- EU residency: for the pilot we need inference and persistence for EU customers to be in eu-west1. Can Redwood pin inference nodes to region for tenant=EU? If so we can move forward.
- For the streaming integration, we prefer the client to surface function-call responses as an event stream rather than a long-poll response — that maps better to our async worker.

We confirm Wed 6/9 09:00 PT for the technical sync. Samir (cc) will be on the invite.

Sasha
Sasha Nguyen
Platform Lead | MindWave AI
sasha.nguyen@mindwave.ai
